<?php
$first = null;
$last = null;
for ($i = 0; $i < 2; $i++) {
    $object = new class {
        public $value = 3;
        public function identity(): string { return __CLASS__; }
    };
    if ($i === 0) { $first = $object; } else { $last = $object; }
}
$first->value = 9;
$expected = "class@anonymous\0" . __FILE__ . ':5$0';
echo $first !== $last ? 'objects:distinct' : 'BAD:object';
echo '|class:', $first::class === $last::class ? 'same' : 'BAD:class';
echo '|name:', $first->identity() === $expected ? 'exact' : 'BAD:name';
echo '|values:', $first->value, ':', $last->value;
$other = new class {};
echo '|site:', $other::class !== $first::class ? 'distinct' : 'BAD:site';

<?php
namespace AnonymousClassReview;
$objects = [];
for ($i = 0; $i < 2; $i++) {
    $line = __LINE__; $objects[] = new class {
        public $value = 0;
        public function className() { return self::class; }
    };
}
$otherLine = __LINE__; $other = new class {}; $third = new class {};
$one = $objects[0];
$two = $objects[1];
$expected = "class@anonymous\0" . __FILE__ . ':' . $line . '$0';
$otherExpected = "class@anonymous\0" . __FILE__ . ':' . $otherLine . '$1';
$thirdExpected = "class@anonymous\0" . __FILE__ . ':' . $otherLine . '$2';
echo $one !== $two ? 'objects:distinct' : 'BAD:objects';
echo '|class:', $one::class === $two::class ? 'same' : 'BAD';
echo '|site:', $one::class !== $other::class ? 'different' : 'BAD';
echo '|same-line:', $other::class !== $third::class ? 'different' : 'BAD';
echo '|exact:', $one::class === $expected ? 'yes' : 'BAD';
echo '|other:', $other::class === $otherExpected ? 'yes' : 'BAD';
echo '|third:', $third::class === $thirdExpected ? 'yes' : 'BAD';
echo '|scope:', $one->className() === $one::class ? 'same' : 'BAD';
$one->value = 7;
echo '|one:', $one->value, '|two:', $two->value;

<?php
$value = new class {
    public function capture() {
        return new \Exception('M');
    }
};
$line = __LINE__ + 1;
$e = $value->capture();
$trace = $e->getTrace();
$name = "class@anonymous\0" . __FILE__ . ':2$0';
echo $trace[0]['class'] === $value::class && $trace[0]['class'] === $name ? 'raw:same|' : 'raw:BAD|';
$expected = '#0 ' . __FILE__ . '(' . $line . '): class@anonymous->capture()' . "\n#1 {main}";
echo $e->getTraceAsString() === $expected ? 'text:display' : 'text:BAD';

<?php
function make() {
    return new class {
        public $value = 0;
        public function scope() { return self::class; }
    };
}
$expected = "class@anonymous\0" . __FILE__ . ':3$0';
$before = new $expected;
$outside = new class {};
$first = make();
$second = make();
$first->value = 9;
echo $before::class === $expected ? 'pre:yes|' : 'pre:BAD|';
echo $before !== $first && $first !== $second ? 'objects:distinct|' : 'objects:BAD|';
echo $before::class === $first::class && $first::class === $second::class ? 'class:same|' : 'class:BAD|';
echo $first::class === $expected ? 'factory:exact|' : 'factory:BAD|';
echo $outside::class === "class@anonymous\0" . __FILE__ . ':10$1' ? 'outside:exact|' : 'outside:BAD|';
echo $first->scope() === $expected ? 'scope:same|' : 'scope:BAD|';
echo 'one:', $first->value, '|two:', $second->value, '|before:', $before->value;

<?php
namespace FactoryProbe;
$factory = static function () {
    return new class {
        public $value = 4;
        public function identity() { return self::class; }
    };
};
$name = 'class@anonymous' . "\0" . __FILE__ . ':4$0';
$before = new $name;
$outside = new class {};
$first = $factory();
$second = $factory();
$first->value = 9;
echo $before::class === $name ? 'before:yes|' : 'before:BAD|';
echo $outside::class === 'class@anonymous' . "\0" . __FILE__ . ':11$1' ? 'order:yes|' : 'order:BAD|';
echo $first !== $second && $first !== $before && $second !== $before ? 'objects:distinct|' : 'objects:BAD|';
echo $first::class === $name && $second::class === $name ? 'class:same|' : 'class:BAD|';
echo $first->identity() === $name && $second->identity() === $name ? 'self:exact|' : 'self:BAD|';
echo 'values:', $before->value, ':', $first->value, ':', $second->value;
